items.description: Sec. 4 intro: 'The minimal thickness is set to be 2 ... if not explicitly specified'. Sec. 4.1 body gives no value. Fig. 7 caption says 'minimum thickness of 1.5', and Table 3 row 'Beam' is identical to 'Beam (r=1.5)' (92.7/92.8). The general default and the caption disagree.
readings: r_min = 1.5 element lengths (Fig. 7 caption; Table 3 'Beam' = 'Beam (r=1.5)')
r_min = 2 element lengths (Sec. 4 general default)

items.description: The text calls the parameter 'minimum thickness' (Sec. 4, Fig. 7 caption, Sec. 4.1.2), but Fig. 11 labels it r_min. It is not stated whether 1.5 is the filter radius (as in standard SIMP codes) or the target member width/diameter, which would mean a radius of 0.75. The filter weighting function is also not given.
readings: filter radius r_min = 1.5 element lengths with linear cone weights max(0, r_min - d)
minimum member width 1.5, i.e. filter radius 0.75 (on the unit grid this means essentially no neighbour filtering)

items.description: Sec. 3.1 says thickness control uses 'the Heaviside filter [25]'. Sec. 4.1.2 says a 'density filter' is used for thickness control. Sec. 2.3 adds a Heaviside projection only as a late black-white filter. The text does not say which filter is active in the main iterations, or whether sensitivity or density filtering is used.
readings: linear density filter (radius r_min) throughout, Heaviside projection added only late
Guest et al. Heaviside projection filter (minimum length scale) used from the start
sensitivity filter (Sigmund) throughout plus late Heaviside projection

items.description: Sec. 2.3 and Sec. 4.1.1 name the Heaviside projection of Guest et al. but give no projection form, sharpness beta, threshold eta, or continuation schedule. Fig. 9(b)->(c) (steps 44->45) suggests the gray design becomes 0/1 in one step.
readings: Guest form 1 - exp(-beta*rho~) + rho~*exp(-beta) with beta continuation 1, 2, 4, ... up to about 64
tanh threshold projection with eta = 0.5 and a large fixed beta (about 32-64) switched on at once
hard 0/1 thresholding at 0.5 at the switch step

items.entity: start time of the Heaviside (black-white) projection
items.description: Sec. 2.3 says the black-white filter is applied 'in the last few steps'. Sec. 4.1.1 and Fig. 9 instead show projection at step 45 of a 166-step run, right after the relaxed-constraint stage (step 44), followed by about 120 more self-supporting iterations.
readings: switch on at about iteration 45 (right after the relaxed-constraint stage) and keep it on to the end
apply only during the final few iterations before convergence

items.entity: overhang-constraint tolerance epsilon (schedule and final epsilon0)
items.description: Sec. 2.3: epsilon 'is decreased continuously from a relatively large value to the predefined tolerance epsilon0' (the soft strategy of [24]). The start value, epsilon0 and the decrease law are not given.
readings: epsilon starts at U of the coarse design (about the number of unsupported elements) and decreases linearly to epsilon0 of about 0 over about 25 iterations (steps 20->44 in Fig. 9)
geometric decrease (e.g. epsilon <- 0.9*epsilon per iteration) to epsilon0 = 1e-3
epsilon0 = 1 (about one unsupported solid element) reached near the end of the run

items.entity: support-detection threshold replacing 0 in the sign function (Eq. 8)
items.description: Sec. 3.2: for gray densities 'a specific value usually needs to be set to replace 0 in the sign function (8)'. The value is not given, and neither is whether it applies to the 3-element convolution sum or to each density.
readings: element supported if the sum of the 3 underlying densities > 0.5
element supported if the sum > 0.1
element supported if the sum > 0.01
binarize densities at 0.5 first, then require the sum > 0

items.entity: density field used in the overhang constraint U(rho) and its sensitivity
items.description: Eqs. (4) and (6) write U and its sensitivity (2*rho_e) in terms of rho_e. With a density/Heaviside filter, it is not stated whether U and the convolution detection use the raw design variables or the filtered/projected physical densities, or whether the sensitivity is chained through the filter.
readings: U and detection on physical (filtered/projected) densities, sensitivity chained through the filter
U and detection on raw design variables, using Eq. (6) directly with no filter chain rule

items.entity: stopping value M_nd^0 for the initial coarse (unconstrained) stage
items.description: Sec. 2.3 defines M_nd with a 'x100%' factor (a percentage) but sets M_nd^0 = 0.36, explained as 'average density of 0.1 or 0.9' (4*0.1*0.9 = 0.36, i.e. 36%). Fig. 9(a) shows the switch at step 20 with a still-gray design.
readings: switch when M_nd < 36% (0.36 as a fraction), about iteration 20 per Fig. 9(a)
switch when M_nd < 0.36% (literal percent reading; almost fully 0/1 starting design)
switch after a fixed 20 iterations

items.description: Sec. 2.3 only says problem (4) 'is ready-to-solve using the MMA approach'. It does not confirm MMA for both the reference and self-supporting runs, and it gives no MMA parameters (move limit, asymptotes, constraint scaling).
readings: MMA (Svanberg) for all stages with standard parameters (move 0.5, asyinit 0.5)
MMA with move limit 0.2
OC (move 0.2) for the unconstrained/reference stage, MMA after the overhang constraint is added

items.description: No stopping rule is given for the reference run or the self-supporting run. Only Fig. 9 shows the final design at step 166.
readings: max design-variable change < 0.01
relative compliance change < 1e-3 together with zero unsupported elements
fixed run length of about 166 iterations (Fig. 9(g))

items.entity: final strict removal of unsupported elements
items.description: Sec. 2.3: remaining unsupported elements (at most 5) are removed 'in the last few iteration steps (when the number of unsupported elements is no longer decreasing)'. The trigger (how many stagnant iterations) and whether optimization continues afterwards are not specified.
readings: set remaining unsupported elements to void once the count stops decreasing for a few iterations, then keep iterating
remove them once after convergence, with no re-optimization

items.description: The starting design of the unconstrained/coarse stage is not given. Sec. 4.1.1 says the volume fraction 'decrease[s] and finally reaches to a stable state' (Fig. 10(c)), which hints the start may be above 0.6.
readings: uniform rho = 0.6 (= target volume fraction)
uniform rho = 1 (full domain)

items.description: Eq. (4) and Sec. 4.1 give f = 0.6 but not whether V uses design, filtered or projected densities. Sec. 4.1.1 reports the volume fraction decreasing to a stable value, and the final element removal lowers it further, so the achieved final volume is unclear.
readings: volume of physical (filtered + projected) densities kept at 0.6
volume of design variables <= 0.6 (the projected design may deviate from 0.6)

items.entity: settings of the support-needed reference run (Fig. 8(a), C_ref = 92.7)
items.description: Sec. 4.1 and Table 3 say only that the reference is computed 'without considering self-supporting constraint'. It is not stated whether it uses the same Heaviside projection/black-white step and stopping rule as the self-supporting run. This affects its 0/1 layout, the count of 24 unsupported elements, and C_ref.
readings: same filter and Heaviside projection as the self-supporting run, run to convergence
filtered SIMP only (no projection); gray design and its compliance as is
filtered SIMP, then thresholded at 0.5 only for counting unsupported elements

items.entity: point load at middle of right edge
items.description: Sec. 4.1 says only 'an external force exerted on the middle point of its right edge'. The direction is shown only in Fig. 7. The analogous 240x60 case in Sec. 4.2 says the force 'points downward'.
readings: vertical, downward (-y)
vertical, upward (+y): mirror-image layout, same compliance

items.entity: point load at middle of right edge
items.description: No load magnitude is given. Sec. 4 only says load data are 'dimensionless'.
readings: any other value (compliance scales with |F|^2)

items.description: Sec. 4 gives E = 1 and nu = 0.3 but does not say whether the 2D analysis is plane stress or plane strain.
readings: plane stress
plane strain

items.description: The thickness of the 2D model is not given anywhere.
readings: other t (compliance proportional to 1/t)

items.description: Eq. (4) only states 0 < rho_e <= 1. The minimum density or Ersatz void modulus is not given.
readings: rho_min = 1e-3 with E_e = rho_e^3 * E
modified SIMP E_e = E_min + rho_e^3 (E - E_min) with E_min = 1e-9

items.description: The mesh is fixed at 150x60 = 9000 unit square elements (Sec. 4.1 + Table 3), but the element formulation is not stated (Sec. 4.2 only says 'square FE elements').
readings: 4-node bilinear (Q4) elements with standard 2x2 integration
higher-order 8-node (Q8) elements
